rina: heads-up: bringing up sakura-lite int8 profile on staging. quick smoke showed two locale-y issues we should triage. :eyes:

 tom: what failures? short repro would help.

 rina: two distinct symptoms: (A) Japanese polite forms (keigo/honorific markers) are being paraphrased out — tone shifts to blunt/informal. (B) Arabic+latin mixed lines sometimes render parentheses reversed and occasionally lose trailing punctuation. only reproducible on the int8 path.

 yuto: only int8? which kernel/profile combo?

 rina: int8 build with matmul-optimized v3 + fused-softmax enabled. fp32 and q4 tests look fine.

 amir: can you paste the metric delta for a small onboard subset?

 rina: short numbers from the politeness-preserve subset (ja->en):

 ```
baseline (fp32): BLEU=30.9, COMET=0.46
int8 (matmul-v3+fsoft): BLEU=25.7, COMET=0.13
delta: BLEU -5.2, COMET -0.33
```

 qa: ouch. example inputs/outputs to show the effect?

 rina: ja source: "先生がお読みになりますか？"
fp32 out: "Would the teacher read it? (honorific preserved)"
int8 out: "Does the teacher read it?"  <-- loses honorific nuance

 amir: and the arabic example?

 rina: ar source: "هل يمكنني استخدام (API) الآن؟"
fp32: "Can I use (API) now?"
int8: "Can I use )API( now"  <-- paren order flipped, sometimes trailing ? dropped

 yuto: that looks like a detok+bidi-visible artifact. any raw token-id diffs between fp32 and int8 runs?

 rina: yes — token counts are the same but the raw ids show an extra 0 in the int8 trace for mixed-direction contexts. pasted snippet:

 ```
fp32 ids: [2134, 21, 765, 998]
int8 ids: [2134, 21, 0, 765, 998]
```

 rina: the extra 0 is inserted between punctuation and the adjacent token, which leads the detokenizerto treat the paren as separated and triggers bidi reordering.

 tom: possible causes: a) quantized softmax underflow / argmax picking a nul token, b) KV cache pointer/stride bug in matmul-v3 transpose, or c) off-by-one in the postprocess trimming.

 yuto: i'll run a focused svmap+asan pass on matmul-v3 with mixed-dir prefixes to see if any loads/stores get misaligned. running: `tools/kernel_trace.sh --kernel matmul-v3 --cases mixed-bidi --verbosity debug`

 infra-bot: staging deployment applied: staging/sakura-lite/int8-2026-03-21-177777 (snapshot)

 qa: i kicked `./scripts/locale_check.sh --model sakura-lite --profile int8-v3 --cases ja-keigo,ar-paren` and attached compact trace:

 ```
[repro] case=ja-keigo
[repro] generated_ids: ... 2134, 21, 0, 765, 998
[repro] detok -> "Does the teacher read it?"
```

 amir: thanks. short-term mitigation: add a detok sanitizer that collapses/removes NUL (0) tokens and normalize punctuation grouping before unicode-bidi runs. low-risk and should hide the symptom while we find the root cause.

 tom: +1 for the sanitizer, but also add two smoke checks to the model-onboard suite: 1) ja-keigo-preserve (exact match on honorific markers for a small list), 2) ar-paren-bidi (parens orientation + trailing-punct presence). block int8 candidate if either fails.

 yuto: accepted. i'm on kernel traces (ETA ~2.5h). i'll post a high-precision sampling trace to see whether the 0 originates from sampling or is injected later in the pipeline.

 rina: created ticket ML-2100 with minimal failing inputs, metric diffs and the repro commands (internal link: https://redwood-internal/p/ML-2100). tagging runtime, tokenizer and evauls.

 qa: i'll add the two smoke tests into the preflight CI and a small repro harness that runs on every int8 candidate.

 amir: if kernel traces confirm a mem/stride bug, prepare a rollback for matmul-v3 on int8 paths and keep the sanitizer as a guard.

 rina: thanks everyone. i'll keep this thread live with traces and the ML-2100 updates. :pray:
